terms.title: Terms of Service
intro: Welcome to Mioshy. The service is operated by Bugo Media LTD ("the Company", "we", "us"). Use of the website and the service is subject to the terms below. Please read them carefully - using the service constitutes acceptance of these terms.

acceptance.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
body: By using the Mioshy website, purchasing a subscription, downloading content, or signing in with a user account, you indicate full and irrevocable acceptance of these Terms of Service and of our Privacy Policy. If you disagree with any term, please refrain from using the service.
You confirm that you are 18 years of age or older, and if the service is used together with a partner, that they too are an adult and consenting.

service.heading: 2. Description of Service
body: Mioshy provides digital couples games, content, and guided programs through subscriptions or one-time purchases. The service is delivered via web browser in Hebrew and English.
list: Online couples games: the Relationship Wheel, Couples Snakes & Ladders and more.
Adults-only content available via the relevant subscription.
A personalized couples Journey including an assessment and ongoing guidance content.

account.heading: 3. Registration & User Responsibilities
body: Creating an account requires you to supply accurate and truthful information. You are responsible for the security of your credentials, for the activity carried out under your account, and for keeping your password safe.
You may not transfer your account to another person, share it with anyone other than your partner, or sell access to it.

payment.heading: 4. Payment & No-Refund Policy
body: All sales are final. Once payment is processed, no refunds will be issued, including but not limited to: subscription fees, one-time purchases, in-game credits, or any digital content delivered to your account.
Prices are displayed inclusive of Israeli VAT for purchases from Israel; for purchases from other jurisdictions, prices are displayed in accordance with applicable local tax rules.

cancellation.heading: 5. Service Cancellation
body: You may cancel your subscription at any time from your personal account page. Cancellation stops future billing but does not refund past payments.
After cancelling, you will retain access to subscribed content until the end of the current billing period; access will then be revoked.

liability.heading: 6. Limitation of Liability
body: The service is provided "AS-IS" with no warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee that the service will be available without interruption, free of errors, or fit for any specific purpose.
Our total liability to you for any claim arising from your use of Mioshy shall not exceed the total amount you have paid to us in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.
Mioshy is not a substitute for professional couples counseling, psychological advice or medical treatment. If you are in emotional distress, please contact a qualified professional.

You may not copy, redistribute, publish, translate, create derivative works from, or commercially exploit any of the content without the Company's prior written consent.

refund.title: Refund Policy
intro: This page explains Mioshy's refund policy. It supplements - and does not replace - our Terms of Service.

policy.heading: All Sales Are Final
body: Mioshy sells digital content that is made available immediately after payment. Accordingly, and consistent with standard practice for digital services: we do not issue refunds on subscriptions, one-time purchases, or any digital content delivered to your account once payment has been processed.

why.heading: Why?
body: The moment a payment is approved, the content is unlocked in your account. Unlike a physical product that can be returned in sealed packaging, digital content cannot meaningfully be "returned" - so our model is forward-looking cancellation rather than retroactive refund.

cancel.heading: How to Cancel a Subscription
body: You can cancel your subscription at any time from your personal account page ("My Mioshy" → "Account"). A cancellation will:
• Stop the next recurring charge and prevent any further charges.
• Not refund payments that have already been made.
• Keep your access active until the end of the current billing period.

billingErrors.heading: Billing Errors
body: If you believe you were charged in error (a duplicate charge, an incorrect amount, a charge after cancellation, etc.) - that is a billing dispute, not a refund request, and we are happy to look into it.
Email us at mioshyoffice@gmail.com with the charge details. We will get back to you within 5 business days, and where an actual error is confirmed we will refund the relevant amount.

consumer.heading: Consumer Rights Preserved
body: This policy does not derogate from mandatory consumer protection rights under the Consumer Protection Law, 5741-1981 and its regulations, to the extent applicable to you. If you believe you are entitled to a refund under applicable law, please contact us and we will review the request on its merits.

privacy.metaDescription: What data Mioshy collects, how it is stored, and with whom it is shared.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
intro: Your privacy matters. This document explains what information we collect, how it is stored, and who may have access to it. For any question, contact us at mioshyoffice@gmail.com.

dataCollected.heading: Information We Collect
dataCollected.body: While using the service, we collect the following information about you:
list: Account details: full name, email address, preferred language and country.
Payment details: payments are processed by Stripe and Cardcom. We do not store your credit-card data - only a transaction identifier and invoice metadata.
Service activity: which games you played, questions and answers you saved, sign-in dates, and aggregated usage data.
Technical information: IP address, browser type, operating system, anonymous device identifiers and language settings.

cookies.heading: Cookies & Analytics
body: We use cookies to remember your language, keep you signed in, and measure aggregated usage of the service. You can block cookies in your browser settings, but doing so may degrade the experience.

thirdParties.heading: Third Parties
thirdParties.body: Data is stored and processed with leading infrastructure providers, all subject to strict security and privacy standards:
list: Supabase – user data storage and database hosting.
Vercel – website and application server hosting.
Cloudflare – networking and security services.
Stripe and Cardcom – payment processing only; credit-card data is never sent to us.
Brevo – transactional email (account confirmations, password resets, account notifications).

rights.heading: Your Rights
rights.body: To the extent we hold personal information about you, you are entitled to:
list: Access the information we hold about you.
Request correction of inaccurate details.
Request deletion of your account and the personal data associated with it.
Object to certain uses of your data, where operationally feasible.

retention.heading: Data Retention
body: We retain personal information for as long as your account is active, or as long as it is required to operate the service, enforce our terms, or comply with legal obligations (such as tax-record retention obligations under Israeli law).
Once an account is deleted, identifying information is erased or anonymized within a reasonable period; aggregated, non-identifying data may be retained for usage analytics.

children.heading: Minors
body: The service is intended for users aged 18 and over and is not directed at minors. We do not knowingly collect information about minors. If we learn that we have, we will delete it as soon as we identify it.

contact.heading: Contact Us About Privacy
body: For any privacy-related request, question or complaint - please email us at mioshyoffice@gmail.com. We will do our best to respond within 14 business days.

accessibility.metaDescription: Mioshy's commitment to WCAG 2.1 Level AA and to Israeli accessibility regulations.
accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
intro: Mioshy is committed to making its service accessible to all users, including people with disabilities. We work in line with the Israeli regulations on accessibility for service (Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities Regulations (Service Accessibility Adjustments), 5773-2013) and with the Israeli standard SI 5568, which is based on WCAG 2.1 Level AA.

commitment.heading: Our Commitment
body: We treat accessibility as a baseline value. Our team continuously improves accessibility and addresses issues as they are identified. We aim for ongoing compliance with the Israeli web-accessibility standard (WCAG 2.1 AA) and to keep raising the bar over time.

features.heading: Accessibility Features
features.body: To make the site easier to use, the following adjustments have been implemented:
list: Full keyboard navigation, no mouse required.
Compatibility with common screen readers (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, TalkBack).
Color contrast meeting the standard (minimum 4.5:1 for body text).
Browser text scaling supported up to 200% with no loss of content or functionality.
Semantic heading structure (H1–H4) enabling structured navigation with screen readers.
Accessible forms with clear labels and explanatory error messages.
ARIA tagging on buttons, links and interactive elements.
Full bidirectional support (RTL in Hebrew, LTR in English).

limitations.heading: Known Limitations
body: Some game content includes animation and sound that are essential to the experience. Wherever possible, an alternative is provided (mute, pause animation). We are continuing to expand these alternatives.
If you encounter an element that is not accessible - please tell us, and we will address it as quickly as possible.

We undertake to respond to accessibility reports within 14 business days, and to remediate substantive issues within a reasonable time.

journeyHub.metaTitle: Journey with Mioshy - Personal Coaching from the Experts
journeyHub.metaDescription: A relationship assessment, an expert who learns the two of you, and a personal plan that updates with you. Journey with Mioshy - both partners, every tool, all included.
journeyHub.preheader: A Mioshy expert paired with every couple
journeyHub.lede: Some of our content is pre-tuned to your assessment. From the moment you sign up, our experts follow your answers, ask you new questions over time, and build a new relationship dynamic for you. Psychologists and couples counselors from our team — you get the full package, all of it tuned to you.
journeyHub.resumeHint: You've got an assessment in progress — the path is waiting.

why.title: No more generic advice. A path built around you.

0.p: A short assessment maps your relationship across 7 dimensions. Your roadmap starts exactly where it needs to - not where a generic course says to start.

1.p: No content dumps. A new chapter opens each week - a practice, a challenge, or a shared conversation. Enough room to feel it, try it, come back to it.

2.p: Every piece is co-written with couples therapists. Practical, research-based, actually doable - not Instagram quotes.

3.p: Both partners see the same journey. Mark conversations, write reflections, and watch how you grow - together, for real.

0.title: Map your relationship in 5 minutes
0.body: A short assessment of communication, intimacy, emotional connection, friendship, and family. By the end you'll see exactly where you stand - no jargon, no filler.

1.title: Get your personal diagnostic
1.body: Instant results: your 3 strongest areas, your 2 biggest friction points, and the one thing most worth working on first.

2.title: An expert + weekly practice
2.body: Your Mioshy expert learns your relationship, builds a custom plan, and follows you in private chat. Short practices that add up to about an hour a week — at your pace.

inside.title: Small practices that change a lot

0.p: Little connection moments - 5 minutes a day that build the couples muscle.

1.p: Guided prompts that open up places you don't always reach on your own.

2.p: One thing each week - an outing, a gesture, an experiment - that pulls you out of the routine.

3.p: Short clips from couples therapists, with space to write what came up.

ctaBlock.title: The assessment is free. The journey starts when you're in.
ctaBlock.sub: 5 minutes, a professional diagnostic, and a personal plan waiting. No commitment, no credit card — just direction.

forWhom.title: Is this coaching for you?
forWhom.lead: It's not for everyone — by design. It's built for couples who feel something's off and know they want to do real work.

0.title: Couples a year+ in
0.body: Who want to maintain a good relationship over time and get couple-tools at a steady pace — not only in crisis.

1.title: Parents of small kids
1.body: Who have no time for their relationship, feel something is missing, and need a frame that brings them back to each other without adding hours to their day.

2.title: Married 20+ years
2.body: Who feel apart even when they're together. You've been through a lot. This coaching is a way to stop, see each other again, and find what was lost.

3.title: Anyone who wants better
3.body: You don't have to be in a crisis to want it to be better. If something's been bothering you — this is the time to handle it.

4.title: Those who believe it can be different
4.body: If you feel your relationship can look different, feel different — and that it's up to you — this coaching is for you.

0.q: What do we actually get with the coaching?
0.a: A 10-minute personal assessment, a work plan refreshed monthly, full access to every game on Mioshy (including Mioshy's Sex), and direct chat with our experts. Everything's included in the weekly subscription — no add-ons, no surprises.

1.q: Who are the experts following us?
1.a: Couples psychologists, family counselors, and couples therapists with 10+ years of experience. Each couple is paired with a personal expert who learns you over time and builds your plan — not a chatbot, not a template.

2.q: What problems does the coaching actually solve?
2.a: Emotional distance, communication that escalates to fights, lack of intimacy, recurring friction, the feeling of "we lost ourselves". We don't promise a fix for everything — but 90% of couples see meaningful improvement within 6 weeks.

3.q: How much time does it take per week?
3.a: About an hour a week total — based on your bandwidth. A short practice every day or two, one longer conversation a week. Your pace, not ours.

4.a: Yes. Data is encrypted. Only your personal expert sees the answers. We don't sell information, no ads, no third party. Billing shows only as Mioshy.

5.q: Can we pause or cancel anytime?
5.a: Anytime, one click. No contract, no penalties. After cancellation no further charges — and your content stays accessible until the end of the current billing period.

6.q: What if one of us isn't ready?
6.a: Start alone. Most couples start that way — the other partner joins within two-three weeks once they see something's moving. The assessment can start with one person and build from there.

faq.headline:
Got questions?

We've got answers.
faq.description: We've gathered the questions couples ask us most. Still didn't find your answer?
faq.item1A: Mioshy is a platform for couples — games, a personal assessment, and weekly guidance from an expert. Our team works in couples therapy, intimacy, and counseling. One goal: to bring back the butterflies you thought you'd lost.
faq.item2Q: Is this a substitute for couples therapy?
faq.item2A: Not exactly. We're a preventive solution - for couples who feel something has eroded but aren't ready to jump into therapy. If there are real crises, we'll also recommend a licensed therapist, and on some plans we'll even connect you with one of our experts.
faq.item3A: Depends on the plan you pick. If it's a game - you get online access and start your first night together. If it's the close coaching - you start with a 10-minute assessment and get a personal plan with monthly tasks. You continue month by month, no contract - and stop whenever you want.
faq.item4Q: How long until we feel a change?
faq.item4A: Couples report a change after the very first night - mostly in the conversation and openness. A meaningful, lasting change is usually felt after 30 days of consistent work. In short: faster than you'd think.
faq.item5A: Absolutely. All your data is encrypted and never shared with anyone - ever. We don't sell data and we don't show ads. Your privacy - and your partner's - is sacred to us.
faq.item6Q: What if my partner isn't on board?
faq.item6A: More common than you think. Our suggestion: don't ask your partner to sign up for guidance — ask them to play one game. One evening, no labels. Most couples who start this way end up keeping going together.
faq.item7Q: What's the difference between the three plans?
faq.item7A: Online couples games: easy entry, access to all games on the platform, flexible monthly subscription. Close coaching with the experts: our most comprehensive plan - everything included: all games (including Mioshy's Sex), personal assessment, tailored plan, monthly tasks, and direct support from the team. Mioshy's Sex: exclusive bedroom games, purchased separately per game. You can mix - and many do.
faq.item8Q: "Close coaching with the experts" - is everything really included?
faq.item8A: Yes, really. This plan bundles everything into one weekly subscription: access to every game on the platform (Mioshy's Sex included), a 10-minute assessment with a relationship expert, a personalised plan, monthly tasks, and direct chat with your expert. No add-ons, no surprises on your invoice. We want you focused on the relationship — not on figuring out what's covered.
faq.item9Q: Can I cancel at any stage?
faq.item9A: Absolutely. No commitment, no penalties. Cancellation is one click in your account, or a quick message to support. No questions, no hassle.
faq.item10Q: We're not married - does this still fit?
faq.item10A: Of course. Mioshy fits every couple in a romantic relationship - married, partners, engaged. The only criterion is that you want to deepen the connection.
faq.item11Q: Who is this content for, exactly?
faq.item11A: For now, our content and tasks are tailored to heterosexual couples - a man and a woman. We're working on expanding the content to all kinds of relationships, and hope to share an update soon.

reviews.item1Text: "I bought '52 Ways to Drive You Wild' as a birthday gift for my husband, just to mix things up and surprise him. No high expectations, a couple of drinks, and we had an amazing night. Great game — recommend."
reviews.item2Text: "We tried couples therapy before - it helped for a moment, but every session felt heavy. The minute we joined Mioshy's coaching, everything got light. Sharing and tending to the relationship became fun. Strongly recommend..."
reviews.item3Text: "We've been customers for 4 years. Every time I tell Yuval 'maybe we should cancel?' something new drops. New kit, new challenge, a game we hadn't seen. They just don't let us get tired of each other. After 16 years."
reviews.item4Text: "I'll put it like this - Monday-night talk in our house is now: 'what's the task this time?' Idan races to check Mioshy first. Something I never thought could happen with us."
reviews.item5Text: "I took my husband to a hotel for his birthday and suddenly realized we had no plan for the evening. I downloaded a Mioshy game, and it saved the night. We laughed, drank, and talked about things we'd never talked about. He still brings up that evening."
reviews.item6Text: "On Valentine's Day every restaurant was packed, so instead of going out we downloaded a Mioshy game at home. It was a way better night than any restaurant we hit this year. Seriously."
